rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=2, unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=0.00021567, epochs=4, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=iter-2 RE-DISPATCH (breast-ct redo, search-20260703-01). Prior iter-2 attempt (train_n=3600/ep3) CRASHED: CUDA OutOfMemoryError at solver line 217 proj.fbp(train_noisy) -- the solver precomputes the FBP init for ALL train sinograms in ONE GPU batch, so 3600x512x512 blew GPU memory (it also landed on an 11GB GTX 1080 Ti before the node-exclusion fix). FIX: train_n 3600 -> 2400 (respects the coordinator train_n<=2400 cap; the whole-train FBP precompute now fits the excluded->>=24GB nodes with expandable_segments), epochs 3 -> 4 so total gradient exposure (2400*4=9600 sample-epochs) still exceeds iter-1's 4800 and doubles distinct-data coverage vs the 400 iter-1 used. This RE-DISPATCH keeps the SAME ONE KNOB intent as iter-2 (train_n up = data-coverage lever) at a memory-safe size. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) iter-1 (train_n=400/ep12): hr 0.7737, SSIM 0.9957, PSNR 49.23, RMSE 1.18e-3, params 3.699M, elapsed 393.2s=6.55min. iter-2-attempt-1 (train_n=3600/ep3): CRASH OOM, elapsed 17s, no result.json. (2) FAILURE MODE (attempt-1) = GPU OOM from whole-train FBP precompute at train_n=3600, NOT a metric issue. Underlying limiter for the SCIENCE is still DATA COVERAGE (iter-1 loss plateaued at 2e-6 by ep8 on only 400 cases). (3) ONE KNOB (vs iter-1): train_n 400 -> 2400 (6x more distinct training cases, memory-safe). epochs 12 -> 4 to fit the wall AND keep sample-epochs (9600) at 2x iter-1. (4) HYPOTHESIS: training on 2400 distinct cases lifts hr above 0.7737 because iter-1 was data-coverage-limited; the bigger, memory-safe train set generalizes better to the 200-case val split. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.7737 at train_n=2400/ep4 -> 4 epochs too few on the larger set (optimization-limited) and iter-3 adds epochs; if it OOMs again, iter-3 must shrink train_n further or the solver's whole-batch FBP precompute is the hard ceiling. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20min=1200s): iter-1 measured 393.2s at 400*12=4800 s-e. At 2400*4=9600 s-e = 2x train work: train ~= 2*(393-90)=606s + fixed ~130s (bigger h5 load) ~= 736s = 12.3min < 1200s, comfortable. max_train_s=1000 fences a runaway. val=200 distinct val_truth.h5 cases, 256px inscribed-circle FOV (breast default). (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign; gate on iter-2 numeric-headroom obs via iter_wait.sh then dispatch iter-3.
